description.narrative: The Project consists of an IFC investment for its own account, in Serbian Dinars (RSD) equivalent, in Minimum Requirement for Own Funds and Eligible Liabilities (MREL) debt instruments to be raised by Raiffeisen Banka a.d. Beograd (RBRS or the Bank). The proceeds will support the banks Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) portfolio with at least 60% of proceeds to be allocated to Women-owned MSMEs (W-MSMEs).

The most significant, expected project-level outcome is increased access to finance for MSMEs, primarily be allocated to projects aimed at strengthening social responsibility (W-MSMEs). Beyond the project level outcomes, IFC anticipates that the Project will promote greater market integration by reactivating and deepening domestic capital markets in Serbia and enabling local corporate bond issuers to mobilize capital at scale from private investors, including from abroad. In addition, the Project, as part of a programmatic approach designed to promote issuance of MREL-eligible debt instruments by systemically important banks, is expected to improve the resilience of the banking sector in Serbia through the demonstration and replication channel.
